chunks: It was narrated from Samāʿah ibn Mihrān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Breastfeeding is twenty-one months, so whatever is less than that is an injustice to the child.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the minimum breastfeeding period?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the proper period of breastfeeding is twenty-one months. It presents reducing that period as a form of unfairness toward the child, highlighting the child's right to proper early care.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4661 - It was narrated from Sama'ah ibn Mihran that Abu Abdullah (as) said:
"Breastfeeding is for twenty-one months, and anything less than that is an injustice to the child."
